anomaly_label: Increased distillate flow to distillate receiver (V003)

evidence.observation: Reflux flow essentially zero (~0.005 L/h) for 20 min while distillate FT704 ~1.9 L/h — no reflux, so column runs at total takeoff
Reported ratio ~5.5-6.4 inconsistent with measured FT703/FT704, suggesting ratio signal not derived from actual reflux flow
Reboiler temperature drifting steadily upward 273.9→278.5 °C while all column stage temperatures (T702-T712) remain flat

args.missing_evidence: Distillate/bottoms composition analysis, and verification of reflux valve/pump state or FT703 calibration to distinguish a true no-reflux condition from a failed flow transmitter
